system.description:
Limitations: Must be imbued onto a worn item. The shell itself can't be relocated once placed.

You create a stationary dome, with a radius of 10ft plus your INT in feet, around yourself and nearby party members. The dome physically blocks Mobs from entering or attacking those inside, unless the Mob is non-corporeal. It does not block magic, and crawlers inside can still act normally.

Note: this stationary area-denial zone with INT-scaled radius has no structural support - track manually.

upgrades.description: Duration increases to 10 seconds, and it also blocks non-Spell attacks originating from outside the shell until the end of the current round.
